name: lritter-agent-skills
description: Lincoln Ritter's personal agent skills: session handoff, daily planning, and self-reflection.

plugins.name: advise
plugins.description: Consult a reviewer model that reads this session's full transcript and advises before you commit to an approach. A user-triggered stand-in for the built-in advisor, with a model you choose (defaults to fable). Invoke with /advise:advise.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a handoff document capturing session state, then apply it — return the contents, dispatch a subagent, or start a fresh session. Two skills that pair: create-handoff writes, perform-handoff executes.

plugins.name: plan-my-day
plugins.description: Morning planning routine. Reads calendar, PRs, tickets, email, and Apple Reminders, checks standing priorities against the week so far, and produces one clear agenda for today. Includes gym-schedule for looking up class times at a Virtuagym-hosted gym.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Analyze the conversation for learnings and update the relevant skills. Use at the end of a session, or whenever a correction is worth keeping.

plugins.name: claude-session-files
plugins.description: Record the files Claude writes or edits, per session, into /tmp so a tmux popup picker can preview them newest-first. Pairs with ~/.config/tmux/claude-file-picker.sh.
